question: What mantra form results from joining haṃsa at the end of the entire sequence?
premises: Haṃsa is joined at the end of all components.
This addition produces a specific form.
inference: Joining haṃsa at the end of the whole sequence yields the twenty-syllable form.
plain_english: When joined with haṃsa at the end of all, it then becomes the twenty-syllable form.
